requirements: R1: Fix the backup service initialization where /scripts/backup.sh is mounted as a directory instead of a file

slices.title: Fix backup service script mount
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to ensure /scripts/backup.sh is properly mounted as an executable script, so that the backup service starts successfully and the assembly health check passes
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application assembly is launched
When the backup container initializes
Then the backup script executes successfully without 'Is a directory' errors and the assembly passes its health check
